fields.title: Chiller 1 Compressor Bearing High Temperature Warning

fields.title: Surgical Pavilion AHU Differential Pressure SLA Threshold Breach
fields.description: Air handling static pressure below 1.2 in. w.g. for > 60 minutes in acute surgical block. Hospital infection control compliance notification dispatched.

fields.description: Hoistway acoustic accelerometer detected 0.28 g peak vibration during high-speed travel. Drive controller interlocked in emergency stop.

fields.title: Ammonia Refrigeration Discharge Gas Superheat High Alarm

fields.title: FM-200 Clean Agent Cylinder Manifold Pressure Below Regulatory Minimum
fields.description: Master gaseous agent pressure dropped to 310 PSI (minimum 330 PSI at 70°F). Mission-critical server hall fire suppression at risk.

fields.title: Cummins Hospital Standby Generator Monthly Load Bank Test Overdue

fields.title: Vertiv Liebert UPS OEM Module Warranty Expiration Warning

fields.title: Solar Array Inverter String B Ground Fault Code 102

fields.title: Steam Boiler Low Water Cutoff Automatic Burner Shutdown
